title: Mini Kirbies!
description: Replaces the chick/baby chicken texture with miniature Kirbies! Complete with poyo sound effects! ETF and EMF mods not required!
body: This pack replaces the chick/baby chicken texture with miniature Kirbies! The temperate variant is classic pink, warm variant is red, and cold variant is green. Hatch some eggs, throw in some golden dandelions, and have an army of miniature Kirbies by your side! Complete with "Poyo" sound effects!
